description: Prometheus-first runtime triage dashboard. Log hygiene and Explore drilldowns require the optional tracing profile.

options.content: Prometheus-first mode: summary panels stay usable without Loki/Tempo. Expand Tracing-only Log Hygiene only when the optional tracing profile is enabled; otherwise use Overview, Control Plane, and Data Quality for bounded triage and enable tracing only for log/trace drill-down.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="bioetl"} | json | __error__="" | level="warning" | pipeline=~"$pipeline" [$__range])) or vector(0)
topk(8, sum by (event) (count_over_time({job="bioetl"} | json | __error__="" | level="warning" | pipeline=~"$pipeline" [$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "event", "none", "", "")
